title: The Stage Lights That Blinked With the Music
central_conflict: the stage lamps flickered each time the drummer struck a loud beat
decisive_choice: speaker vibrations were shaking a loose power connector behind the lighting rack
resolution: stopped the rehearsal and had the crew secure and safely test the connector
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the stage lamps flickered each time the drummer struck a loud beat before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they changed the bulbs but the flicker returned with the next rehearsal; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized speaker vibrations were shaking a loose power connector behind the lighting rack; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they stopped the rehearsal and had the crew secure and safely test the connector, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Rain Gauge That Predicted a Flood

title: The Bell That Rang With No Boat
central_conflict: the harbor bell rang every night although no boat approached the pier
decisive_choice: a floating marker struck a loose metal bracket only when the tide reached its highest point
resolution: secured the bracket and marked the high-water hazard for the harbor crew
